duration_s.principle: Standard methodology field; measured wall-clock duration for the precondition and diagnostic run.

field_principles.duration_s: Standard methodology field; measured wall-clock duration for the precondition and diagnostic run.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Standard methodology field; names the actual substrate used for deterministic numerical testing.
field_principles.jacobian_antisymmetry_fraction: Fraction of the update Jacobian that is antisymmetric; >0 implies a non-conservative (curl-bearing) field EBT cannot express.
field_principles.n_states_sampled: M>=50 instances so the curl/residual estimates are not single-trajectory artifacts.
field_principles.positive_control_fit_residual: Same fit on a KNOWN conservative field must give ~0 residual -- proves the test detects conservativity and a large TRM residual is real, not a fitter failure.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Standard methodology field; records torch/numpy and checkpoint-source gates before TRM inference.
field_principles.random_seed: Standard methodology field; deterministic numerical test, real compute over M states.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Standard methodology field; stable checksum catches silent source or configuration drift.
field_principles.scalar_potential_fit_residual: Relative residual of the best -grad(E) fit to TRM's update field; large residual = TRM != energy descent.
